description: The document head on every page now ends with one async verification loader after the site script. The line is static markup, so the builder passes it through untouched, and this log entry ships in the same change.
lead: One async loader in the shared head template proves control of the site to the ad platform. Approval flow unlocks with no ad units, no placements, and no design change.
